message.content: {"caption":"Illustration comparing three approaches to robot learning as human supervision decreases.","description":"A three-part conceptual diagram shows a progression from left to right. In “Supervised Learning,” a person stands beside a robot with a thought bubble showing a red flag; in “Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards,” a person points toward a running robot, also with a flag in its thought bubble; and in “Absolute Zero (Ours),” two robots appear without a person, with a flag in a thought bubble above them. A long right-pointing arrow beneath the panels is labeled “Less Human Supervision.” Each panel also shows a red flag on a pole.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
